description.value: Bombay Kitchen on Denman is an Indian restaurant in Vancouver's West End, situated on Denman Street — a primary cycling corridor linking the city to Stanley Park. The kitchen serves a broad menu of curries, tandoori dishes, and street-food items like kathi rolls, drawing on traditional Indian recipes and fresh local ingredients. Catering for events from small private parties to corporate gatherings and weddings is also offered.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 36m; stands (4 spaces) at 37m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 77m; stands (3 spaces) at 81m; stands (6 spaces, covered) at 97m. Total: 17 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM phone number and supplies the street address absent from OSM ('1061 Denman St, Vancouver, BC'). The site confirms online ordering with free delivery (takeout) and explicit vegetarian/vegan and gluten-free options in the menu and catering pages; no mention of bike parking, washrooms, or Wi-Fi appears anywhere in the fetched content. The OSM name 'Bombay Kitchen + Bar' diverges from the website's consistent branding as 'Bombay Kitchen On Denman', flagged in concerns.
